issues.issue: Was the RAD's finding that it was implausible the PSB would do more than make random visits to the applicant's home reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: The RAD did not explain why the narrative was implausible; harassment by random visits was a PSB punishment method.
issues.result_quote: The RAD fails to adequately explain why the Applicant’s narrative on this point is implausible

issues.issue: Was the RAD's finding that the applicant could not have left China on her own passport with a smuggler's bribes reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Bribery of officials was plausible; the customs officer only stamped the passport; the RAD ignored this evidence.
issues.result_quote: the determination that the Applicant could not leave China on her own passport is simple speculation on how one can leave China.
